faq.question: Q1. What is SGOU Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Sreenarayanaguru Open University to engage 7 Data Entry Operators on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for the Data Entry Operator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 11/11/2026 at 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or Diploma along with a Certificate in Computer Course of not less than 6 months from a Government recognised Institution, or have computer as a subject of study in their Degree Course.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 01/01/2025, with relaxation to Reservation Community as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for SGOU Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly payment of Rs. 23,360/-.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the University website at www.sgou.ac.in/

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates who applied previously need to apply again?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already submitted their applications pursuant to the earlier notification need not apply again, but they can update their credentials.
